tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Check if ChatGPT, Google, Claude, Perplexity and Grok can find, read and recommend a website. Fetches the page like an AI crawler (raw HTML) and returns a 0-100 score and grade, SEO/AEO/GEO category scores, the top issues to fix, and links to the full results and a shareable score card. Takes about 10 seconds. Free, no key; results are private.

url.description: Website or page to check, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page
